propositions: Direct and aliased ambient configuration/credential reads (load_config, os.getenv, os.environ subscript/get, literal getattr, backend property reload) must be rejected below approved composition seam boundaries by deterministic AST gate
All declared configuration and credential names must have exactly one registered owner in the central registry, with legacy migration exceptions eliminated before contract phase closure
Ownership gate must be wired into both portable local linting (make lint) and CI workflows with proof that both invocations execute and fail if either is omitted

Generated config/security/operator documentation must be byte-current with authoritative schema and ownership registries and cover lifecycle, precedence, restart, observability, subprocess, and behavior-delta topics

Legacy facades, migration switches, and ambient reload paths must not be removed until focused test suites, S1-S6 behavioral regressions, and bounded live canaries (provider, AWS op-cert, reconciler) all pass with operator attestation
